families.prescribed_model: Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross
While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb
Beholding the beauty of thy virginity
Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake
When the stone had been sealed
What shall we call you, O holy ones
With the disciples let us come together
Having laid aside all earthly hope
Let us go up with the disciples

invocations.normalized_rubric: After Ode 3, the Kontakion, and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion; and reading concerning St. Theodore. After Ode 6, the Kontakion of Theodore, and Ikos; and we read the Prologue and Synaxarion. After Ode 9, the Exapostilarion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs 3, Tone 5, Podoben: "Rejoice, O container of ascetics" (Ра́дꙋйсѧ по́стникѡвъ); and for Theodore, Prosomoia 3. Then the Refrain: "We went through fire and water"; and we sing the Idiomelon Sticheron of the Martyrs: "Trophy-bearers of Christ"; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... Theotokion. Litanies, and the Dismissal, and the usual procession into the narthex, and the First Hour. At the Hours, the Troparion of the Martyrs; Glory of Theodore; Both now... the Theotokion of the Hours; and we say the Kontakia alternating. At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Martyrs, Ode 3 on 4; and of Theodore, Ode 6 on 4. After the Entrance, the Troparion of the Martyrs, and of Theodore, and his Kontakion; Glory of the Martyrs; Both now... of the Theotokos of the temple, or: "O Protection of Christians"; Prokeimenon, Alleluia, and Communion Verse of the Martyrs and of Theodore; the Epistle and Gospel first of Saturday, and of Theodore according to pericope, then of the Martyrs.

invocations.normalized_rubric: *Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi], the 1st antiphon of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon of the Feast. "Let every breath praise the Lord;" Gospel of the Feast. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon of the Feast with Heirmos on 8; and of the Akathist on 6. Katavasia of the Feast, both choirs together. But the Four-ode Canon we do not sing here; rather we sing it beforehand, on Thursday at Compline. After Ode 3, 3 Kontakia, and 3 Ikoses; and again the 1st Kontakion. After this, Sessional Hymn, and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, 3 Kontakia, and 3 Ikoses; then the Kontakion: "O all-hymned Mother," thrice; and the 1st Ikos; and the Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader;" and we read the Prologue, and the Synaxarion. At Ode 9 we do not sing "More honorable than the Cherubim," but we sing the refrains of the Feast, as was indicated for the Feast itself. Unto the troparia of the Canon of the Akathist the refrain is: "Most Holy Mother of God, save us." Then at the Katavasia we sing the refrain and the Heirmos: "As the animate ark of God;" and a bow. Exapostilarion of the Feast. At the Praises, Stichera of the Feast, Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the heavenly ranks" (Небе́сныхъ чинѡ́въ), on 4; Glory, both now: "Let the heavens be glad;" Great Doxology; Troparion of the Feast; litanies, and dismissal. And holy oil is given unto the brethren according to custom; and the Catechesis of St. Theodore the Studite; and the 1st Hour in the narthex.*
